high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "science_documents." The post features a detailed map of the Solar System, showcasing various celestial bodies and their orbits around the Sun. The map is visually complex, with multiple concentric circles representing different regions of space, each containing labels for planets, asteroids, and other astronomical objects. The text overlay on the image reads: "Most detailed map of Solar System in front of you," indicating that the post aims to highlight the intricacy and comprehensiveness of the map being shared.
